description.text: Business Administration is a comprehensive discipline that studies organizational operations, resource management, and business decision-making. Its core objective is to cultivate business professionals with systematic management thinking, strategic vision, and practical capabilities, in order to address the challenges faced by various institutions such as enterprises and non-profit organizations during their operations. From team management of start-up companies to global strategic planning of multinational enterprises, from market expansion to financial management, Business Administration covers the entire process of business activities and serves as the "business universal language" that connects theory with practice.

duration.text: The Business administration at Xidian University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3055 USD/per year ￥ 22000 CNY/per year

requirements.text: 1: Applicants must not have aChinese nationality.2:Applicants must be physically and mentally healthy (free from infectious diseases and any physical or mental diseasethat would have impact on the normal study), and must abide by Chinese laws and regulations, as well as XidianUniversity's school rules and regulations, and respect China's social morals and customs.3:Applicants must be at least 18 years old.4:Language competency 1) lELTS score of 6.5 or above 2)TOEFLscore of 80 or above 3)Duolingo score of105 or above 4)Applicants with a previous degree taughtin English may be exempted from providingEnglish language test scores if theyprovide relevant proof.
